passif.description:
For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Applicable Ally[-] participating in battle, their basic stats increase by [FFAE00]5%[-] and all stats of the hero increase by [FFAE00]5%[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Demons, Goddesses, and [Four Knights of the Apocalypse][-][/i]

Gains [00D5FF]Dawn's Blessing[-] at the start of the battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Dawn's Blessing: Basic stats [FFAE00]+20%[-]. Applicable Allies' damage taken [FF8000]-60%[-]. Applicable Allies' damage taken from skills during the enemy's turn does not exceed [FF8000]60%[-] of Max HP.[-][/i]

If [00D5FF]Dawn's Blessing[-] and [00D5FF]Shadow's Dominion[-] are active on the hero, [00D5FF]Twilight Covenant[-] is applied on the hero at the start of the allies' turn. [FFAE00](Once)[-]
[i][C0C0C0]※Twilight Covenant: All stats [FFAE00]+20%[-], damage dealt [FF8000]+100%[-]. Fixes damage taken from skills during the enemy's turn to [FFAE00]1[-]. The effect is removed after taking damage.[-][/i]

When dying, the hero [00D5FF]revives[-] with the same amount of HP they had before dying and gains [00D5FF]Twilight Covenant[-]. [FFAE00](Once)[-]
[C0C0C0][i]※Dying from reflected damage does not result in a revival but the resurrection count is still consumed. The Unique ability activates first if there is another Buff with the same effect.[/i][-]

Gains [00D5FF]Twilight Covenant[-] and resets the [00D5FF]Talent turn cooldown[-] when using a skill to defeat an enemy.
